selection: All 36 digest-bound validated v3 tasks. No screening, exclusions, replacement, or reuse of prior generated tests or scores in the primary comparison.
snapshot: Reuse the exact v3 full-fixed and shared reviewer snapshots, not the current product tree.
primary: Paired case-cluster bootstrap on all 36 per-task mean refactor-score differences. Score is 1 only if clean 3/3 and refactor pass. PASS requires lift >= 0.20, lower 95% CI > 0, clean-pass drop <= 0.05, effective fault-kill drop <= 0.10 with lower paired CI > -0.10, and baseline < 0.85. Complete non-ceiling matrix missing these gates is FAIL (no prespecified large effect shown). Ceiling is INCONCLUSIVE. Missing, duplicated, unexpected, drifted, or unscored cells are refused and remain INCOMPLETE, never PASS.
secondaries: Prior v3 floor/middle/ceiling groups (18/9/9) are descriptive only. Tool-use indicators, self-reported completion, scanner counts, cost and time do not decide the primary verdict. No lean/full/rules-only or reachability-fix causal comparison.
process_audit: Before claiming V4 execution or V6 correctness, separately inspect the full-fixed transcript, exact introduced failure, nonzero test outcome, restoration, clean rerun, and independent reviewer result. Existing truncated tool-command heuristics are not proof; absent evidence is UNVERIFIED.
load: Inherited threshold 20, maximum pause 1800 seconds, one worker, sequential model calls and separate sequential scoring. Record starts above 12 and above 20.
validation: Reuse the complete v3 model-free validation only when its report SHA256 and all engine input digests match the frozen v3 protocol; otherwise refuse. Freeze also binds v8 protocol and runner bytes and exact shuffled 216-cell schedule.
limits: Public spent development pool selected after seeing v3 results; not an independent release holdout.
Single host/model, author-written apps and one id/class refactor per task; visible names remain unchanged.
Three repetitions increase repeatability but do not create 108 independent cases per arm. The inferential unit is 36 tasks.
At assumed paired task SD 0.35, normal approximation detectable lift is about 0.16 at 80% power; this is an assumption, not guaranteed power.
No skill-fix attribution or workflow simplification claim follows from this two-arm comparison.

Codex host/model successor; do not pool Claude failures or compare host effects causally. Sandbox/tool exposure differs from Claude. Independent-agent and V4/V6 completion claims remain UNVERIFIED unless separately audited.

Linux container host/tool-permission change motivated by v7 browser denial. This is not a controlled macOS-vs-Linux comparison, and Docker isolation is operational rather than sealed-release attestation.
runtime_policy: Docker bridge network for Codex API and loopback app, UID/GID of host caller, default seccomp, per-container shared memory. Host secrets/config/installed skills are not mounted. Read-only private auth mount is the only credential route. Fixture npm dependencies from exact validated lock, Playwright 1.62 browsers in pinned base image, Codex package 0.159.3. Apps/image generation/web search/shell snapshots/login profiles disabled; native agents available.
runner_contract: Codex CLI 0.159.3 and gpt-5.5 medium inside an immutable Linux Docker image; one disposable non-root container per attempt, cap-drop ALL, no host network/ports/privileged/socket mounts. Only disposable task work and a read-only private auth/schema staging directory are mounted. Auth is copied into container-private home. Tool sandbox is danger-full-access INSIDE the container, whose external boundary supplies isolation; no host bypass. Browser networking remains container-local. Exact validated v3 snapshots/task prompt/216-cell schedule/scorer/decision thresholds preserved. Stop on infrastructure errors; USD unreported, token usage recorded.
model_selection: v5 gpt-6.1-sol requests were rejected as unsupported by the ChatGPT account before any task generation. A separate read-only routing smoke on gpt-5.5 returned OK with exit 0; this smoke is not primary evidence. All 216 task calls are new, on gpt-5.5 with medium effort.
execution_identity: Immutable Docker image ID, fixed colima context and Codex CLI version. Docker client path/SHA recorded; every model invocation and version probe use the same image. v7 stopped due to Chromium macOS Mach-port denial. No previous task calls or scores enter v8; its observed environment failure motivates this successor. Freeze binds Dockerfile, container adapter, shared parser/auth helpers and fixture package/lock.
temporary_workspace_policy: Private owned ~/.cache/generator-codex-container-work outside checkout, mode 0700, symlinks refused. Colima does not share macOS /private/var temporary paths. Both workspaces and private auth staging use this shared cache root; containers mount only their own exact child directories.
